sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩看見一位路人大人或店員生氣罵人，她站在主角媽媽旁邊覺得害怕。畫面要清楚呈現大人生氣罵人讓孩子害怕，但不要畫成主角媽媽罵孩子，不要過度兇狠；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

Do not copy any specific person, clothing, hair, face, or body shape from L058. Use protagonist family continuity from L154/L162/L163 for the recurring little girl, protagonist mother, and protagonist father when present. Keep all meaning-bearing subjects centered with safe margins. No visible text, letters, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, brands, logos, or readable marks. Keep scolding scenes gentle and child-safe: no bullying, no adult rage at a child, no humiliation, no violence, no frightening emotional pressure. Scene: safe public indoor or storefront-like area without signs. A passerby adult or shop clerk is visibly upset and scolding another adult off to the side, not scolding the protagonist little girl. The protagonist little girl stands close beside the protagonist mother and looks afraid. The mother calmly protects and reassures her. Make clear that an angry adult scolding people can make the child afraid, but keep expressions restrained and non-threatening.

sentences.imageNotes: 兩個孩子或一個孩子和路人大人之間發生大聲責備情境，被罵的孩子嚇到退縮，旁邊有主角媽媽或老師溫和制止。畫面重點是被人大罵會嚇到；不要畫成成人暴怒威脅孩子，不可有文字、數字、標籤。

sentences.text: 做錯事被罵，忍不住哭了。
sentences.spokenText: 做錯事被罵忍不住哭了
sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩不小心做錯事，例如打翻玩具或弄亂桌面，被溫和提醒後忍不住哭了，主角媽媽在旁邊安撫。畫面要清楚呈現做錯事、被罵後忍不住哭；不要畫成嚴厲責罵或羞辱，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
